room_description: A dark, mysterious underground cave with glowing green moss, a pool of water, and strange carvings on the walls.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the dark cave environment.
Finding a beetle on a mossy rock.
Inspecting a small pool of glowing water.
Using a knife to scrape fungus off a rock.
Examining a piece of cloth with red symbols (a pickaxe and numbers).
Entering symbols into a lock on a wooden box.
Finding a coil of rope inside the opened box.
Looking at an analog clock with colored hands.
Using the rope to climb out.

items_used: Piece of paper with colored lines
solution_steps: Find the paper showing a yellow, purple, blue, and red line intersecting.
Look at the clock on the wall and note the numbers each colored hand points to.
Enter the corresponding code (9246) into the lock.
Examine the cloth to see the red symbols.
Enter those exact symbols into the combination lock on the wooden box found in the dark crevice.

final_action: Using the rope combined with another item (likely a hook) to climb up and out of the cave.
